title: memory_recap contract
description: Get a recap of recent work with ADHD-optimized card summaries. Derived from MemoryRecapRequest (dope_memory_main.py:774) and DopeMemoryMCPServer.memory_recap (dope_memory_main.py:318).

scope.description: Scope of recap: session (current session), today, or last_2_hours

trajectory.description: 1-sentence trajectory summary, e.g. 'Working on debugging, implementation activities'

title.description: Card type: Decision, Activity, Blocker, Error, or Next

cards.description: Up to top_k cards. Card 1: Decision or top activity. Card 2: Blocker/Error. Card 3: Next suggestion.
